AC13.note: src/harness/process/sandbox/unattended.test.ts: 23 real-launcher tests (bwrap) — KERYX_DANGEROUSLY_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 refuses; non-Linux host refuses; no launcher refuses; a launcher that cannot create a namespace refuses; env allowlist-only (HOME/XDG/TMPDIR point at scratch home, tokens/SSH_AUTH_SOCK absent); filesystem home hidden wholesale, private /tmp, network unshared by default; T14: /run hidden wholesale, resolv.conf bound back only for network:true; dispatch.network:true is the only way to keep the network; toolchain roots from PATH under home; credential dir under /home/altsay invisible; exported token/SSH_AUTH_SOCK not in env; host /tmp not visible; network off = loopback only; worktree+scratch home writable, real home not; T14: find / -type s empty, /run empty; T14: a socket the test itself listens on under host /run is unreachable; T14: abstract-namespace sockets invisible with network off, visible with network on. src/commands/trigger-dispatch.test.ts describe(AC13: trust never runs uncontained; ask is read-only): 'trust with no sandbox refuses before any model call, reservation, worktree or attempt' + 'ask with no sandbox runs, but every command and patch is refused — nothing lands' + 'the default health gate runs keryx health run and health gate INSIDE the sandbox, with its env' + 'with no sandbox the health gate does not run the worktree's code at all' + 'shell_exec under the real sandbox takes the worktree's maintenance lock; the lock dir is never committed'. These are live-sandbox tests that skip cleanly where bwrap cannot create namespaces (e.g. CI); on this machine they did not skip — bun test src/harness/process/sandbox/unattended.test.ts run today: 23 pass / 0 fail, 64 expect() calls, confirming bwrap is functional here and every boundary probe (credential file, env token, network) actually ran and passed, not vacuously. This matches journal T13/T14 notes recording the same live probes during implementation, and the T14 security re-review (hiding /run, abstract sockets) which found and fixed the /run AF_UNIX gap live. Full 10-file run today: 181 pass / 0 fail.

AC14.note: src/commands/trigger-dispatch.test.ts describe(AC14: spend is reserved before the first model call and never fails open): 'two concurrent reservations for one trigger: exactly one gets the allowance (real overlap under the spend lock)' + 'a killed run's reservation keeps counting until an operator resolves it with the real spend' + 'a response with no usage stops the run, fails the attempt, and charges the whole reservation' + 'a throw while writing the closing attempt still records the cost and closes the reservation' + 'only providers known to report usage are accepted'. Fresh run today: 181 pass / 0 fail.

AC15.note: src/commands/trigger-dispatch.test.ts describe(AC15: a killed run's worktree does not wedge the trigger branch): 'a live stale worktree left on trigger/<flow>-<task> under the dispatcher's parent is recovered' + 'a registration whose directory is already gone is pruned' + 'the branch checked out somewhere the dispatcher did not create is never touched — refused as a conflict'. Fresh run today: 181 pass / 0 fail.

Security review of PR 650 showed the text floor is bypassable (sh -c quoting, gh api, curl, update-ref) and that containment was not real: the sandbox allowed network, passed exported tokens, exposed ~/.config/gh-work, shared a writable /tmp, was skipped silently when no launcher existed, and the health gate ran agent-written code with no sandbox at all. The floor stays as defence in depth; the boundary moves to a mandatory, hardened sandbox.

Security review of PR 650: containment was not real (network on, exported tokens and ~/.config/gh-work visible, shared writable /tmp, sandbox skipped silently without a launcher, health gate ran agent code unsandboxed) and spend could go unrecorded (killed runs, providers without streamed usage, concurrent triggers each seeing the full allowance, zero rates). These criteria make the boundary and the budget contractual.

Security review of PR 650: a killed run left its worktree registered to the trigger branch, so every later fire failed at git worktree add with exit 1 forever.
